summary: Ascella signed-coherence coefficient acquisition: 64 settings, 27 primary endpoints, theory atlas and frozen native request
scope: One 64-setting Ascella order-family job measuring sign-odd and sign-even X/Y and sign-averaged dark coefficients at five angles plus a commuting mutation, under a 300-second cap and a 1.2-credit ceiling, with the coefficient atlas rendered from its retained counts.
next_action: Test a drive-dependent heater response (per-heater nonlinear phase error of the returned phases) by leave-one-configuration-out on job-00, the one shared mesh family left untested; if it also fails to predict left-out configurations, naming the per-configuration error behind X0 + Xc2 needs applied-voltage calibration data from the provider or a hardware case that repeats one configuration under perturbed compilations. A timing budget for larger sample counts still needs controlled repeats that vary only the samples per iteration.

reconciliation.note: The approved acquisition ran and is retained with its reproducing analysis; all 27 endpoints qualify. The outside-block share above the dark-count bound remains an open mechanism question.

steps.action: Generate the serialized 64-setting request: twelve-entry input, twelve-mode circuit, output width twelve, explicit empty mitigation, budgets and exact entry order.
steps.acceptance: A builder writes the request with a digest, and a check rejects any setting whose full unitary, analyzer or output width differs from the design.

receipts.result: The builder writes the 64-iteration twelve-mode template request; gate core-680 validates the retained bytes against Perceval and the closed-form operators and refuses a perturbed unitary, exchanged X/Y analyzers and a four-mode input occupation.

The builder writes the 64-iteration twelve-mode template request and, through qd_platform.payload without sending, its serialized job body (Perceval estimate 524,288 shots); gate core-680 validates the retained case and body against Perceval and the closed-form operators and refuses a perturbed unitary, exchanged X/Y analyzers and a four-mode input occupation.

steps.action: Replay the frozen request through the local SLOS backend and run the registered estimators on the ideal response, the equal-contrast mutation counterexample and the sign-even counterexample.
steps.acceptance: The ideal replay qualifies every primary endpoint; the equal-contrast counterexample fails mutation closure; the sign-even counterexample keeps all fifteen sign-odd and dark coefficients ideal and fails tolerance-conformance on the three sign-even coefficients replay.py names; the weak 0.05 twist excludes the exact ideal while conforming to the coefficient tolerance.

receipts.result: SLOS and Naive replay the 64-entry body with twelve-mode single-photon outputs matching the manifest within 1e-12; the ideal and sampled responses qualify all 27 endpoints, the equal-contrast case fails mutation closure, the 0.2 sign-even twist keeps the 15 sign-odd and dark coefficients ideal and falsifies exactly the derivation's three sign-even coefficients, and the 0.05 twist excludes their ideal while every endpoint qualifies.

SLOS and Naive replay the 64-entry body with twelve-mode single-photon outputs matching the manifest within 1e-12; the ideal and sampled responses qualify all 27 endpoints, the equal-contrast case fails mutation closure, the 0.2 sign-even twist keeps the 15 sign-odd and dark coefficients ideal and falsifies exactly the derivation's three sign-even coefficients, and the 0.05 twist excludes their ideal while every endpoint qualifies. Missing and zero-eligible iterations yield no decisions.

steps.action: Write the acquisition case with fresh availability, tariff and expected credits, and wait for the user's approval.
steps.acceptance: An approved case names the request digest, samples, cap and expected credits; without approval nothing is submitted.

receipts.result: The owner approved the written acquisition case on 2026-10-24; the submission record quotes the approval, the 1.016384-credit ceiling, 524288 samples and the 200-second expectation.

steps.action: Under the approved case, preflight, submit the frozen body once, collect the raw result and run the registered analysis on the retained run.
steps.acceptance: A retained run directory under results/quandela/runs/ holds the receipt, raw result, results.json and analysis.json that ascella_coherence_run.py --run reproduces; the run enters research_state.json and the strategy run log.

receipts.result: Job 739a5271 completed 524288 samples in 186 s for 1.016384 free credits; ascella_coherence_run.py --run reproduces analysis.json, in which all 27 endpoints qualify and 1.27 percent of events fall outside the logical block; claim ascella-signed-coherence-conformance and the strategy run log carry the run.

steps.action: Diagnose job-00 outside-block clicks and analyzer contrast, preregister a permuted repeat at twice the samples with a between-job comparison, and run it under its own approval.
steps.acceptance: A retained job-01 run whose registered analysis and preregistered comparison replay through their gates, entered in research_state.json and the strategy run log.

receipts.result: Job 6ef8e8db ran the permuted repeat: 27 of 27 endpoints qualify; outside-block clicks follow the execution sequence (lag-1 -0.653) with budget-proportional exposure, not the setting (Spearman -0.075); analyzer residuals reproduce (X 0.974, Y 0.802).
